filing_office: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code
filing_fee_notes: The current fee schedule includes a 5 single-sign-on surcharge in formation and annual-renewal fees.
registered_agent_rules: Provide a qualifying registered agent and a Utah street address for the registered office; a post office box is only a mailing address.
expedite_options: Expedited service costs an additional 75 per filing; turnaround was not confirmed.
annual_report_due: One year after registration and annually thereafter.
plain_english_summary: Formation costs 59 and annual renewal costs 18. Renew each year on the registration anniversary.
common_mistake: The registration anniversary determines the renewal deadline.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Fees come from the schedule effective July 1, 2025. Formation processing time, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
